Für Garagen: Eintauschwerte auf Basis ec: For garages: trade-in values based on real comparable listings instead of gut feeling. The automatic search finds matching vehicles on the market and works out the buying price from them – you can adjust the comparison prices yourself at any time. The first 3 automatic searches per month are free, and manual calculations remain unlimited in every plan.
VIN-Decode – neu auch ohne Konto: VIN decoding – now also without an account
Fahrgestellnummer eingeben, Fahrzeugdate: Enter the chassis number and import the vehicle data. This now also works without logging in, directly in the listing flow – so you don't have to register first to see whether your data is recognised correctly.
Ein Flow für Direktkauf und Leasingübern: One flow for direct purchase and lease takeover
Statt zwei getrennter Wege gibt es jetzt: Instead of two separate paths, there's now a single listing flow: you enter your vehicle and decide along the way whether to offer it for direct purchase, as a lease takeover – or both. Garages can also add a new leasing offer.
Käuferauswahl beim Verkauf: Choose the buyer when you sell
Wenn du dein Inserat als verkauft markie: When you mark your listing as sold, you choose straight away who bought it. The buyer automatically receives a confirmation, and for a lease takeover you get a checklist of the steps still needed to transfer the contract.
«Privatanbieter» statt Klarname: «Private seller» instead of your real name
Auf Inseraten wird neu dein echter Name: Your real name is now shown on listings – which builds trust with interested buyers. If you'd rather not, flip a toggle in your dashboard and you'll appear as «Private seller» instead. Your choice, and you can change it at any time.
Anfragen bleiben auf BuyAuto statt zwisc: Enquiries stay on BuyAuto instead of getting lost between WhatsApp and email. On mobile, the area is now much larger, the other person is clearly shown in the conversation header, and new messages once again reliably trigger an email notification.
Standort-Autocomplete für die ganze Schw: Location autocomplete for all of Switzerland
PLZ oder Ort eintippen und auswählen – d: Type in a postcode or town and select it – the suggestions now cover every Swiss municipality. Fewer typos in listings and cleaner results when someone searches in their region.
Du siehst, wie oft dein Inserat angescha: You can see how often your listing has been viewed. This helps you judge whether a vehicle isn't getting enough visibility or whether the price is more likely the issue.
Die Pakete für Garagen wurden neu geschn: The garage plans have been reworked: clearer tiers, a fixed allowance of trade-in valuations per plan (Starter 25, Growth 100, Pro 400 per month) and prices that match across every page.
